models_evaluated: mechanistic 0D cardiopulmonary digital twin with constrained model predictive control
unlisted_practices: Closed-loop model predictive control of ECMO using a physiology-based digital twin, evaluated in silico against static and heuristic control strategies

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates an automated closed-loop digital twin and model predictive control framework in simulated in silico cohorts (ARDS and cardiogenic shock) to control ECMO settings, without testing an organizational deployment safeguard or human interaction.
